# Workshop orientation

The handling handbook and courier notes use READY for different objects and actions. Consult their separate definitions. A third source conflicts with the handling handbook on the valve condition, and the library has no basis for declaring a winner.

Read [handling](kb:knowledge:handling@1), [courier](kb:knowledge:courier@1) and the [unresolved judgment](kb:judgment:readiness-conflict@1). There is no supplied humid-room procedure or explanation of physical safety.
